name: Acarigua

queries.query: Acarigua Portuguesa Venezuela official cadastral map parcel viewer registry
queries.result: Search results did not identify an English-language first-party parcel viewer. They identified the official Páez municipal cadastral directorate page and the national IGVSB site; the latter exposed general cartographic/mapoteca material, not a city parcel service.

queries.query: Acarigua Portuguesa Venezuela catastro parcelas mapa visor oficial Alcaldía de Páez
queries.result: The official Alcaldía de Páez page identifies Dirección de Catastro in Acarigua and lists avalúos, registro de propiedades, solvencias catastrales, and control urbano. No public map/API or downloadable parcel layer was identified in the page or linked municipal routes.

registryBasis: The official Alcaldía de Páez page evidences a local Dirección de Catastro in Acarigua, Municipio Páez, with cadastral property-registration and urban-control functions. This establishes a local custodian, not a public parcel API or downloadable parcel dataset.

officialSources.observation: Official municipal page lists Dirección de Catastro at the municipal building in Acarigua and services including avalúos, registro de propiedades, solvencias catastrales, and control urbano.

officialSources.publisher: Instituto Geográfico de Venezuela Simón Bolívar
officialSources.observation: Official national institute site exposes general geographic/cartographic resources and links to Mapoteca; no Acarigua cadastral parcel layer was found in the inspected page.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A local cadastral custodian is evidenced, but no public parcel service, native parcel identifier, or anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained. Research completion is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
